title: A simple and cost-efficient route to prepare sulfonated dihalo-monomers for synthesizing sulfonated aromatic PEMs
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37272-37277
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06283C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nodar Dumbadze, Marco Viviani, Klaus-Dieter Kreuer, Giorgi Titvinidze
A new simple and cost-effective method for the synthesis of sulfonated aromatic monomers is presented, offering a drastic reduction in the number of purification procedures and waste production.
